name: bedtime
title: Bedtime
description: Gentle, hushed, kind; children's stories and sleep narration.
instruct: Speak gently and softly like reading a bedtime story to a child, kind, hushed, warm.
sample: And so the little robot closed its eyes, one light at a time. [pause 500ms] The stars hummed softly above the workshop. Tomorrow there would be more to fix, more to learn. [pause 400ms] But tonight, everything was exactly where it belonged.
